quotes.text: Accept online payments with PayNow, a funds transfer service popular in Singapore.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Use `stripe.confirmPayNowPayment` to confirm the payment on the client side.

findings: November 7, 2026 new raw lines 5-14 establish PayNow as an online payments option and point to Checkout and Direct API Markdown variants. This capture contains the common introduction and routing only, with no variant prerequisites or lifecycle evidence.

May 6, 2026 old raw lines 16-39 document Singapore business eligibility for Checkout, SGD across line items and one-time payment mode, with hosted or embedded Checkout and separate Terminal routing for in-person use. Old raw lines 54-105 show the dynamic method route and manual inclusion, with success_url for hosted Checkout and return_url/embedded_page in the embedded example. Old raw lines 111-117 distinguish Stripe's simulate-authorize-or-fail test flow from live scans in participating apps and document the post-payment Checkout return.

May old raw lines 129-162 and 164-234 cover the Direct API prerequisites, SGD PaymentIntent, PayNow method inclusion and server-to-client secret boundary. Old raw lines 235-279 document client confirmation, scanning and authentication in a participating app, inline QR, and keeping the customer informed until a result or fulfillment. Old raw lines 281-289 document the successful PaymentIntent transition and payment_intent.succeeded webhook for server-side completion.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain May 6, 2026 Checkout details under the dated capture, including Singapore business and SGD conditions, one-time mode, hosted versus embedded return behavior, and test versus live QR procedures (old raw lines 16-39, 54-117).

Retain May 6, 2026 Direct API details under the dated capture, including PaymentIntent and client-secret responsibilities, inline QR and participating-app authentication, waiting for the result, and server-side success from payment_intent.succeeded (old raw lines 129-162, 164-234, 235-289).

source_assessments.reason: Existing summary needs guide- versus product-scope, sample versus requirement, and payment-status corrections even though the new raw is a navigation reference.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paynow/accept-a-payment, new raw lines 5-14 establish only the online PayNow introduction and Checkout and Direct API links. The May 6, 2026 capture documents Singapore businesses using one-time Checkout payment mode with SGD line items, hosted or embedded Checkout, manual or dynamic payment-method selection, and customer QR scanning before Checkout returns to the site in old raw lines 16-117. In old raw lines 129-289 the merchant creates a SGD PaymentIntent on the server, passes the client secret to the customer side, and uses client confirmation to display the inline QR. The customer authenticates in a participating app, and successful completion produces a succeeded PaymentIntent and payment_intent.succeeded for server-side handling. source-stripe-paynow-accept-payment.md captures that structure but overstates the product-wide Elements exclusion, the Direct API example's field requirements, and the implication that scanning or closing the QR establishes a formal payment state.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paynow/accept-a-payment, new raw lines 5-14 present the two variants as navigation on November 7, 2026. The capture does not establish a substantive behavioral change. Keep the May 6, 2026 conditions and evidence as dated guidance in source-stripe-paynow-accept-payment.md, including Checkout eligibility, currency, one-time mode, returns and simulated versus live QR in old raw lines 16-117, and the Direct API inline QR with server-observed success in old raw lines 129-289. Qualify the two guide variants separately from broader Payment Element support and the Express Checkout Element exclusion documented by the method overviews. The May Checkout samples add PayNow alongside card, and Direct API sample fields and closure handling need example scope. Preserve the existing concept-to-source route in wiki/concepts/stripe-real-time-payments.md and record the reciprocal route on the acceptance source for later reconciliation.
